recommendations: Consider moving the CWE-190/323/330 mentions out of evaluation/README.md's prose (tester-facing) into a more clearly internal-only document, to reduce any risk of accidental exposure if evaluation/README.md is ever shown to participants.

The SR3 auxiliary static-scan fallback (regex for bare 'counter++;') is a reasonable diagnostic aid but could be documented as strictly non-authoritative in code comments within evaluate.py itself, not just in evaluation/README.md, for extra clarity to future maintainers.
